utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay, can everyone see the sheet? Zainab, I think you're muted.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Not muted. Just quiet.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sorry I'm late, the train just sat outside the station for like ten minutes, no announcement, nothing, and then-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: No worries, we literally just started. So, uh, autumn launch budget.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Is Chidi joining? He said he might.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: He's stuck on a vendor call. He sent notes but nothing that touches this.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, so, can I- sorry, can I just start? I've been chewing on this since Monday.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Go for it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: We've got the launch money, and I keep coming back to, um, getting a real chunk of it in front of actual buyers. So forty-six thousand on the sponsorship at the Northern Logistics Expo. The booth one.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Forty-six out of what, again?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Out of roughly a hundred and ten. Finance said one-twelve, but a little of that's already spoken for.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So that's, what, forty percent-ish. On one event.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Well, yeah, but-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: No, I'm only saying that's a lot of eggs. Sorry, go on.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: So last year's stand, we scanned about three hundred and ten badges, and out of those thirty-eight turned into real meetings, like qualified ones. And this time the attendee list shows twenty-four hundred buyers who look like our ideal customer.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Did any of the thirty-eight close?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Um. I'd have to look. I'm not sure we tracked it all the way through.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I have it, hang on. Seven went to proposal, and, uh, four signed. Check with Rania though, she had the CRM export.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Four signed. And what did last year cost us?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Thirty-one, I think- no, thirty-three, with the travel.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So it's costing more this year and we're hoping for the same result.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: The list is bigger though. It's a, it's a bigger room.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Okay, side thing, but last year's hall, the one in Rotterdam, we had to carry all the display boards through the kitchen of the hotel next door, and Daan nearly dropped-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Elif, is it the same venue or not?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh. Different city, I think. Chicago? Or Columbus. Somewhere with a river.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Chicago. It's in the deck.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Is the fee all of it, or is there stuff on top?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Forty-six is the sponsorship package. Stand build and travel would be a different line, eight, nine thousand maybe.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So it's not really forty-six.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's forty-six against launch. The build side I'll confirm with ops.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, devil's advocate. Twenty-four hundred matching buyers, says who?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Their registration data. They filter on job title and company size.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Mm. That's their filter, not ours.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sure, but last year their filter gave us the thirty-eight.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fair.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: What I liked last year is people actually stopped. Like the tote bags, people queued up for-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Bags don't sign contracts.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: No, but they got people to the- okay, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Is anyone looking at something that competes with this for the launch money? Far as I know it's the only real ask.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Only thing on the table.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nothing else is costed.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Then there's nothing to compare it to. Which nags at me, but fine.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right. Diego, the deposit deadline, do you remember?

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Um, early September? The email said the first week or so.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: September fifth, I'm looking at it. Half up front.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So this week or next.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Half is twenty-three, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Twenty-three, yes.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: So are we- is this a yes, or are we still circling?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Wei, can you push the deposit through finance this week? I'll sign whatever they send back.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sure. They'll want a PO or just the invoice?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Invoice and the sponsorship agreement. I'll forward you both after this.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Great. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Do I need to do anything about the bags?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Not yet. Hold off.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Other thing, the newsletter. Camille wants the template frozen before she's out.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: When's she out?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: The fifteenth, I think.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I can freeze it by next Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Is she back before the launch?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Early October, I think. Don't hold me to it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Last time she said that it turned into three weeks more.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Different leave, though.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: True.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Should I loop in Clara on the follow-up list, or wait?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Wait until the agreement's signed.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay. I mean, she'll ask, but okay.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, also, sorry, the offsite survey. Has anyone filled it in? Because Rania said she needs it by-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Friday.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Friday! Yes. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I'll do it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Please do, it's only five questions.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Four.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Four. Okay, I've got another call at the top of the hour, so-

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Go, go.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Thanks all. Talk Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay, is everyone here? Diego, I can see you but I can't hear you.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sorry, there we go. Better?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yep, thanks. So I've got the expo follow-up, and then the ad copy thing, which is bugging me.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Which first?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Whichever. Elif, you had your hand up?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry, it's about the expo, so it probably belongs first anyway. I emailed the organiser last week because the registration counter on their site looked really flat to me.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: They wrote back yesterday evening. They're now expecting around fourteen fifty people through the door.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fourteen fifty. Against the twenty-four hundred in the deck?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Yeah, so that's down, what, forty percent or so. Another show got moved into the same week, a rival one, and a lot of people are going there instead.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Which show? Is it the big one in Denver?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: She didn't name it, just said a competing event. And then the part I actually care about, three of the accounts on our top target list aren't coming. They told the organiser themselves.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Three of the top ones. Do you know which three?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: She listed them, it's in the email, I can forward it. One is the freight forwarder we've been chasing since spring.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Huh. Okay. That's, um, not great.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: So we pay forty-six thousand for a smaller room, and the people we most wanted to meet aren't in it. That's poor value.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: It's still a room full of buyers though. Fourteen hundred is a lot of people.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: A lot of whom? Not the ones on the list.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Other side for a second. Last year we scanned about three hundred badges. Fewer people could mean more time per person at the stand.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Or fewer leads.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah, or that. I'm not defending it, I'm poking at it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: And honestly the tote bags would have gone further with a smaller crowd, we'd run out of the good ones before-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Elif, hang on, I want to stay on the numbers.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sorry. Yes.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. Is the fourteen fifty a projection or is that registered?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Projection, I think. She said "confirmed" but I read it as their estimate.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: So it could move.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Could go up a bit, sure. Probably not back to twenty-four.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Can we get them to knock something off the fee? If the show is smaller?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Maybe. I wouldn't count on it, the agreement's already signed.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: It's signed, but they moved the show's week on their own, or around it. That's got to be worth a conversation.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Fair. I'll ask.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Deposit's paid?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: It's with finance. Should land tomorrow, they said, or Friday latest.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Leave it where it is. I don't want to change anything off one email. Elif, can you ask her for the attendance number and the account list in writing, from the organiser's side?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Sure. Today?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Today is good. And I'll come back to this next week once we've got something firm.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: So it's, like, paused?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's not paused. It's where it was. I just want better data before anyone says anything else about it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I'll send it right after this.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Thanks. Okay. Ad copy.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Is this the Tuesday thing, where the launch ads got stuck?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yeah. Anika's team, legal, they review every single ad before it goes out, and the first batch sat there a while.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nine days, last I checked.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Let me look. I had a number. Hang on. Okay, over the quarter the queue averaged about six days.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Six is the average. Mine was nine.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yeah, there's a long tail.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Is that a legal problem or is it our problem? They're busy, right?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's both, honestly. They're two people and we send them everything.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I sent them a banner last week that was literally just the logo and a date. The logo and a date.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes, and?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: And nothing, I'm just saying that went in the queue.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: So the question is who approves ad copy and how much of it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: What if legal only looks at the ads that make a performance claim? The ones that say faster, cheaper, a percent of something.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Just those?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Just those. Everything else we approve ourselves.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Who would decide what counts as a claim?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The person writing it, to start with, and then Amara signs off.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Hm. I'd want a short list of what counts.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sure, that's easy. And the numbers help. Their queue averaged six days, and I went through the last batch, about seventy percent of the ads don't have a claim in them at all.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So most of what's sitting there doesn't need legal to read it.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Seventy sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That's more than I would have guessed. I thought it was half.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I counted twice, because I didn't believe it either.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. And Anika's okay with that? I don't want to hand her team something and not tell her.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I talked to her on Monday. She said fewer is better, as long as the claim ones still come through.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: That's a pretty good sign.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right. Okay. Legal reviews only the ads that make a performance claim, and everything else we approve here.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Starting when?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Starting with the next batch. I'll tell Anika this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Do I write the checklist?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yes please. One page, what counts as a claim. Wei can look it over.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Happy to.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Done by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Quick one, the newsletter template. Camille said freeze it?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I'm freezing it Wednesday. It's on my list.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: She's out the fifteenth, right? I keep forgetting.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: The fifteenth, I think. I'll check the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I was going to loop in Clara on the follow-up list. Is that still wait?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Still wait. Not till the expo thing is settled.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay. She keeps asking.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I know. Tell her end of next week.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, the offsite survey. Did everyone fill it in?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Last week.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Um, no. I'll do it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Rania said she needs the answers by Friday, I think.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's four questions, Diego.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Four. Yes. I know.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay, I have to run, I've got a call with the agency at the top of the hour.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I'll send the email to the organiser in ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Talk Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay, everyone here? Diego, you're muted again.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Sorry. Better?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Better. So, uh, quick one first. Zainab, the claim checklist, did it go to Anika?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Monday. She's fine with it.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Any changes?

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: One more example under comparisons. Wei added it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Last night, yeah. It's in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I had two banners go through this week, and one came back in like an hour, and the other-

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Other one had a claim.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Right. "Twice as fast." Okay, no, I get it now.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: That's the point of the list.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Is the, um, newsletter thing done too? I lose track.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Template's frozen. Since Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Great. Great.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Camille's out now, right? Did she look at the footer first? She had opinions about the-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: She signed it off Tuesday. Footer's the same as August.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Okay. It looked slightly different on my screen but maybe that's just-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Dark mode.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Probably dark mode.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. The launch money. I said I'd come back to it once we had something firm, and we do now, so I want to open it up again and go through it properly.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Elif, tell them what the organiser sent.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: So, um, it's a proper email this time, signature block and everything. Fourteen fifty expected, and she says that's the figure they're giving exhibitors. Not a guess anymore.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So no bounce back up.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: No. And the three accounts are still out. She attached the list.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And I did ask about the fee. They said the agreement stands. They offered two extra passes.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Two passes. That's, that's something.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Not forty-six thousand of something.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: I know. I know. I just keep thinking about the room, though. Buyers all in one place.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: The deposit's paid, the twenty-three, and how that gets handled with the organiser is a separate conversation. Right now I want to know where the money does the most.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Devil's advocate, since nobody's said it. Is there anything else on the sheet? Last time it was only the one ask.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: There's the credit idea. It's been sitting at the bottom.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: The credit one. Honestly I never got my head around the numbers on that.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: I did. The spring pilot, we asked about four hundred customers and got sixty-one referrals back.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Nineteen of those closed. Average deal was around eighty-two hundred.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: And forty-six would cover maybe three hundred credits. No fixed date it has to happen on, either.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sixty-one out of four hundred, so what, fifteen percent?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Fifteen, a bit over. And nineteen of sixty-one is, uh, about a third.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Nineteen at eighty-two hundred. That's, um-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Hundred fifty-something thousand. I'd have to check the sheet for the exact one.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay. But those were spring customers. Friendly ones. They'd say yes to us anyway.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: They closed.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: I'm not saying they didn't. I'm saying it's a pilot.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: It just feels quieter than the expo. Less splash.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Splash doesn't pay.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, that was blunt.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It was accurate.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: And we only pay a credit when a referral qualifies. So it's not money gone before anything happens.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Though three hundred credits means three hundred referrals. The pilot gave us sixty-one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Right, so we probably wouldn't use all of it.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Which is fine, I just want it said.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Can I ask something about the form? Is it the same one as in the spring or did that get changed?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Same one, I think. Wei, you have the old file?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: It's in the shared folder. It needs the new credit wording.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. Wei, can you get the form set up with Elif, and then brief sales on Monday?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sure. Monday morning, before their stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I can do Thursday afternoon for the form. Is that too late?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Thursday's fine.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Okay, I'll block it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Should I tell anyone upstairs? Chidi, maybe?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I'll talk to Chidi. He's out of the vendor call by now.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, good, because he'll ask me and I'll just say "ask Amara."

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: That works.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. Offsite survey, did everyone finish it? Rania wanted it back last Friday and I think it's still short.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: I did mine.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Did mine.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Done.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Um. I did most of it.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Diego.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: There's one question I couldn't parse. The one about travel days.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: It asks how many days you can travel. That's it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Oh. Okay. Then it's done, basically.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Please actually submit it.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Tonight.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Rania said Daan has the venue shortlist, so if survey answers are late he can't narrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Is Daan doing the shortlist? I thought it was Rania.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Both? One of them found the venue and the other one is checking prices. I think.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Okay. I'll ask Rania which. Not a big deal.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Can I ask about the Friday review? Is it still at two?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Moved to three. Calendar says three.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Okay, good, because I had a- no, I have a thing at two thirty.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Three works then?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Three works.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Is the checklist on the agenda for it?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Only if Anika has comments. Otherwise it's done.

utterances.speaker: Zainab
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Okay, I've got a client call at the half hour, so-

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Go. We're done anyway.

utterances.speaker: Diego
utterances.text: Thanks all.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Wait, quick, the Thursday block, is it the small room or my desk?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Your desk is fine. Bye, everyone.
